scope: Structured error handling and validation. The upstream FPM library sources are unchanged; unlimited free-form line length accommodates existing long source lines. Adapted from the author example, the main checks a valid bounded integer in a Result object, rejects an out-of-range integer with expected code 105, checks two retained application trace entries, and triggers a custom noncritical warning while execution continues. The example uses fixed values rather than interactive input. All Result ranks/types, critical-error termination, all validation criteria and every trace-propagation path are not validated.
